subject.title: feat(android): accept audio and document attachments via share sheet and composer

question: Should the Android app ship curated audio and document attachment intake as a supported bundled chat capability after the delivery-path defects are fixed?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Android capability, and the protected `maintainer` label indicates that final ownership and scope should not be inferred solely from the implementation.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded Android feature
options.body: Keep the curated MIME list, require the listed functional repairs and real device/emulator proof, then review the rebased head.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Limit the initial feature to attachment types with a complete Android timeline and gateway delivery contract, leaving the rest for a follow-up.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Decline this bundled Android surface and preserve the current image-only composer until a product owner sponsors the broader attachment UX.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded Android feature
recommendation.body: Keep the curated MIME list, require the listed functional repairs and real device/emulator proof, then review the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: They hold the current implementation context and can route the final Android feature-scope decision to the appropriate project owner.
